what: On first open, a thin patterned ring (mandala) at the center of the background-color curtain spins once every 10s, appearing in 1s, then the logo lights on over 1s and moves up 10% while fading (1.2s expo.out, the ring turns off with it). At 2.5s the background curtain starts fast in 1s power4.out and the contrast-color curtain below starts slowly at .8s expo.inOut, lifting together so the contrast color flashes briefly and goes — at 3.3s the curtain is hidden and fx:done fires.

options.[data-fx-part=first]: Top curtain (background color) — at least one of first or second must exist
options.[data-fx-part=ring]: (If present) pattern ring spinning in the center — SVG inside
options.[data-fx-part=logo]: (If present) Logo that appears and fades over the ring
options.speed: Speed multiplier, default 1 — at 2 it finishes in 1.65s. Raise it for screens opened often
options.at: When the curtain starts lifting (seconds, before speed multiplier), default 2.5 — use 0 for the curtain alone without ring or logo
options.once: If session, from the second visit in the same tab it goes straight in with no veil (the original only runs when entering from outside)
options.--fx-ring·--fx-ring-color: Ring size and line color (via style), default min(607px, 80vw) · --kf-line

note: The curtain has no pointer-events, so the page below can be clicked even while it lifts (as in the original)

from.where: shared.js loader [data-intro] (original intro: mandala circle rotating 10s · circle 1s Power4 → logo 1s Power4 → logo y −10% 1.2s Expo.easeOut(−.2) · circle off 1.2s → beige curtain 1s Power4 (delayed .5, −1) · gray-brown curtain .8s Expo.easeInOut (delayed .3, −1.3))
